records.english: {HEX:01}That ship... I have never seen it before.{LB}I hope they are not pirates...{PAD}

{HEX:01}...That is your ship?{PAD}
{HEX:02}Yes, mine!{LB}But I will not let you call me{LB}‘you’ like that!{PAD}
{HEX:02}...You are military. I can tell by your uniform.{PAD}
{HEX:02}I hate soldiers. They all hide behind power{LB}and bully everyone!{PAD}
{HEX:14}FI, please,{LB}calm down.{PAD}
FI!{LB}That is rude to someone you have just met!{PAD}
{HEX:02}Kamil, be quiet!{PAD}
{HEX:02}If you are trying to pick a fight with me,{LB}you will be disappointed!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:02}What, violence?!{LB}That is what a man with nothing but strength{LB}would think of! Go ahead, try it!{PAD}
{HEX:01}...Do not misunderstand.{LB}I would never strike a woman or child.{PAD}
{HEX:02}Oh...{LB}Are you trying to be a gentleman?{PAD}
{HEX:02}But you will not fool me with that!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:02}Come on, Kamil!{PAD}

{HEX:01}Yes, that is right.{PAD}
{HEX:10}I have heard the rumors.{LB}I am Gerhard Ardelknatts.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Oh, the Admiral Ardelknatts{LB}who hunted pirates...{PAD}
{HEX:10}That was a long time ago...{PAD}
{HEX:10}By the way, Lord Hodram,{LB}why did you tolerate those insults?{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}...There was no point trying to reason with her.{LB}Forgive me, but dealing with people like that{LB}is painful.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:10}...I see. I can understand that.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Hm? What is it...?{PAD}
{HEX:10}Hm, Kamil...?{PAD}
Huff... huff... um...{LB}I am sorry about earlier.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Is there something else?{PAD}
I had to apologize...{LB}I am truly sorry!{PAD}
Please forgive FI.{LB}I did not mean to pick a fight{LB}with any of you.{LB}{PAD}
I once had a terrible experience with a man{LB}who acted superior simply because he was a soldier.{LB}It made me a little oversensitive.{LB}{PAD}
She is really kind and wonderful!{LB}She just jumps to conclusions and gets carried away...{LB}Really, FI is!{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}You are Kamil, right?{PAD}
Huh? Oh, yes.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Your thoughtful apology is appreciated.{LB}I am not offended.{PAD}
R-really?!{PAD}
{HEX:01}Yes. With someone like you nearby,{LB}her talents can truly be put to use.{LB}{PAD}
N-no, not at all.{PAD}
{HEX:01}Do not worry about me. And there is not a single{LB}cruel soldier like that in our fleet.{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:01}My one goal is to become one of the world’s{LB}strongest navies.{LB}I will not harm you. You have my word.{PAD}
Oh, thank you!{LB}...And, Gerhard...{LB}{PAD}
{HEX:10}What is it?{PAD}
About me coming here...{LB}FI does not know...{PAD}
{HEX:10}Yes. We will keep it quiet.{PAD}
Thank you!{LB}...Then, excuse me!{PAD}
{HEX:01}A promising young person...{PAD}

{HEX:01}Yes.{LB}...A promising future indeed.{PAD}
